title: The Belt
definition: Champion. Awarded to the season's league winner. The digital counterpart to the physical PFL trophy.

title: The Bridesmaid Bouquet
definition: Runner-up. Beautiful but nobody wants three of them.

title: The Hammer
definition: The Decisive Player Award. Awarded to the started player whose score most often exceeded the winning margin across the season.

title: The Cannon
definition: Highest single-week franchise score of the season.

title: The Sieve
definition: Most points allowed during the regular season. The defense that stopped nothing.

title: The Benchwarmer
definition: Most points left on bench where the MFL optimal lineup indicator said to start. Entirely self-inflicted.

title: The Clairvoyant
definition: Highest rate of correct lineup decisions versus the MFL optimal indicator. Hardest award to earn.

title: The Climb
definition: Largest improvement in win percentage from the prior season.

title: The Oracle
definition: Franchise whose incorrect lineup decisions most often resulted in a loss they would have won with the optimal lineup. Measures consequence, not volume — the wrong call that changed the outcome.

title: The Banner
definition: Best regular-season record. Awarded to the franchise with the highest regular-season win percentage before playoffs. Honors regular-season dominance — emotionally distinct from the Belt.

title: The Engine
definition: Highest total points scored during the regular season. Honors sustained scoring power across a full season — paired with The Cannon (single-week explosion) as its season-long counterpart.

title: The Black Rose
definition: Highest losing score of the regular season. The franchise that scored enough to beat almost anyone and still lost. Deterministic, emotionally precise, and immediately legible to any fantasy player.

title: The Signal Caller
definition: Highest started quarterback points, season total.

title: The Workhorse
definition: Highest started running back points, season total.

title: The Deep Threat
definition: Highest started wide receiver points, season total.

title: The Tight Window
definition: Highest started tight end points, season total.

title: The Boot
definition: Highest started kicker points, season total.

title: The Wall
definition: Highest started defense points, season total.

title: The Steal
definition: Best points-per-dollar among started players. The bargain that won games.

title: The Burning Money
definition: Worst points-per-dollar among significant bids. The overpay that haunted the season.

title: The Patience Premium
definition: Lowest average bid per started point across the whole draft. Most disciplined auction manager.

title: The Whale
definition: Highest single bid of the season.

title: The Lifeline
definition: Best in-season acquisition of the season, measured by highest post-acquisition started points among players acquired via waivers, FAAB, or free agency. Retrospective only — awarded based on what the player actually delivered after being acquired.

title: The Cavallini Standard
definition: All-time win percentage leader. Held until someone surpasses it.

title: The Dynasty
definition: Most championship titles. Currently held by Paradis' Playmakers (4 titles).

title: The Eternal Runner-Up
definition: Most runner-up finishes without a championship. Currently held by Ben's Gods (3 runner-ups).

title: The Executioner
definition: Most blowout victories above the threshold margin.

title: The Iron Curtain
definition: Best all-time points-allowed average across all regular seasons. Held until someone's career average drops below the current holder's.

title: The Unbroken Chain
definition: Longest consecutive playoff-appearance streak in digital history. Held until surpassed. Honors sustained postseason relevance across seasons.

title: The Floor
definition: Worst single-season record in digital history. Currently held by Brandon Knows Ball (0-14, 2025).

title: The Founder's Seal
definition: All 10 members present since the digital era began. A statement of membership, not a competition.

title: The Inaugural Champion
definition: Robb's Raiders, 2010. First champion of the digital era.

title: The One-Point Club
definition: Championships decided by under 2 points. Cavallini 2013 (1.00 pt). KP 2019 (1.45 pts). Two members. Permanent.

title: The Back-to-Back
definition: Only franchise to win consecutive championships in the digital era. KP 2019-2020.

title: The Perfect Storm
definition: Brandon Knows Ball, 2025. The only 0-14 regular season in digital history. Permanent.
